evaluation_protocol.frozen_model_selection: development validation only; never evaluation outcomes
language_instructions: put the ring inside the bearing
put the ring left of the bearing
put the ring right of the bearing
evaluation_protocol.object_coordinates: reset, record and score only; never passed to runtime policy
evaluation_protocol.policy_api: RGB and own proprioception only; forbidden attributes blocked at runtime
evaluation_protocol.success_definition: controller finished and post-execution target score valid

geometry_protocol.sampling: uniform distance/angle in each cell and conditional feasible bearing interval

scope: Same object dimensions, fixed robot-hidden simulated RGB camera; new positions/directions/distances
